description: Natural Hazards Research Summit 2024: Neural Network Applications in Bridge Seismic Resilience Evaluation is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Farahnaz Soleimani, Oregon State University (oregonstate.edu). Assessing seismic resilience in critical infrastructures like highway bridges can inform emergency planning and assessments of network integrity after hazard events. While machine learning techniques show promise in earthquake engineering, their application to bridge resilience remains under-explored. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-de5v-ha75. Keywords: NHERI, Bridge Resilience, Seismic Resilience, Artificial Neural Network, Performance-based assessment, Probabilistic seismic demands. Published 2024-06-24. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
